newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 10.0/11.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 10.0/11.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 10.0/11.0 percent in late morning trading on Tuesday from 11/13 percent at the opening, dealers said.
They said the fall was mainly due to ample rupiah liquidity following central bank's early injection of 493 billion rupiah.
The central bank offered overnight bilateral SBIs at 5.0 percent, one-week at 6.5 percent, two-week at 8.25, one-month at 10.25, three-month at 10.75, six-month at 11.50 and one-year at 12.0 percent.
The average overnight interbank rate on Monday was 13.78 percent against 13.75 percent on Friday.
